headline: Bank of Thailand Maintains 2.4% GDP Growth Forecast for 2026 Despite Q3 Softness
summary: The Bank of Thailand held its 2026 economic growth forecast at 2.4%, unchanged from previous projections even after third-quarter GDP came in slightly below market expectations.
why: Thailand's monetary policy outlook depends on growth durability against sluggish domestic consumption and shifting regional trade patterns.

impacts.name: Thailand
impacts.why: The central bank maintained its full-year growth outlook at 2.4%.
